exhaustiveAuditMethod.definition: Scalar leaf differences compare every JSON value with explicit MISSING sentinel. Arrays use max(old.length,new.length); objects use union of all keys. Added/removed containers recursively enumerate EVERY scalar leaf. Empty-container presence and container retypes are retained as separate structural events. Array length changes count ONLY two present arrays with unequal lengths; they are NOT scalar leaves.

function row(parts, before, after) { return { path: pointer(parts), pattern: pointer(parts, true), before: encoded(before), after: encoded(after) }; }
